turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good morning. Please sit down. Tell me, what is the problem?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: नमस्ते डॉक्टर साहब। मुझे तीन दिन से पेट में दर्द हो रहा है।
turns.english: Hello doctor. I have had stomach pain for three days.

turns.speaker: Relative
turns.text: ఆమెకు రాత్రి వాంతులు కూడా అయ్యాయి డాక్టర్ గారు.
turns.english: She also vomited at night, doctor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Is the pain on the right side, or all over the stomach?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: दाहिनी तरफ़ ज़्यादा है, और खाना खाने के बाद बढ़ जाता है।
turns.english: It is more on the right side, and it gets worse after eating.

turns.speaker: Relative
turns.text: ఆమె రెండు రోజులుగా సరిగ్గా తినడం లేదు.
turns.english: She has not been eating properly for two days.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any fever? Did you take any medicine?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: हल्का बुखार था। मैंने सिर्फ़ एक पैरासिटामोल ली थी।
turns.english: There was a mild fever. I took only one paracetamol.

turns.speaker: Relative
turns.english: There was no fever this morning.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. We will do an ultrasound of the abdomen and a blood test.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: ठीक है डॉक्टर, रिपोर्ट कब तक आएगी?
turns.english: Okay doctor, by when will the report come?

turns.speaker: Relative
turns.english: We will come again in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The reports will be ready by evening. Please avoid oily food until then.
